description: This file defines the 'SearchRootActor' class, which serves as the primary supervisor actor in a system managing thing searches. It sets up MongoDB connections, initializes persistence layers, manages actor hierarchy, and integrates monitoring tools. It also includes methods for creating related actors and configurations.

classes.name: SearchRootActor
classes.description: Main actor class responsible for supervising the search system, initializing MongoDB, managing child actors, and integrating monitoring and health checking functionalities.

methods.name: getCommandListenerOrNull
methods.description: Returns a MongoDB command listener if command monitoring is enabled in the configuration, otherwise null.

methods.name: getConnectionPoolListenerOrNull
methods.description: Returns a MongoDB connection pool listener if connection pooling monitoring is enabled, otherwise null.

methods.name: getThingsSearchPersistence
methods.description: Initializes and returns the persistence layer for searching things, applying index initialization and namespace hints as configured.

methods.name: initializeSearchActor
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActorRef for the main search actor, configured with the provided limits and persistence layer.

methods.name: getQueryParser
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryParser instance using factory patterns and the provided limits configuration.

methods.name: initializeHealthCheckActor
methods.description: Sets up and returns the health check actor monitoring the search components.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method creating Props for the actor, for use in actor system initialization.

methods.name: getThingsFieldExpressionFactory
methods.description: Creates a field expression factory with customized mappings for thing-related fields, tailored for MongoDB.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Helper method to add a JSON field definition mapping to a field mappings dictionary.
